name: quick-fix-codex
title: Quick Fix (Codex)
description: Fix spelling and grammar of the selected text in any app, powered by the pi CLI with Codex models (uses your ChatGPT subscription, no API key needed).
author: erikmay

commands.name: quick-fix
commands.title: Quick Fix Selected Text
commands.description: Fixes spelling and grammar of the selected text and pastes the corrected version back in place.

preferences.name: piPath
preferences.title: Pi CLI Path
preferences.description: Absolute path to the pi binary.

preferences.name: model
preferences.title: Model
preferences.description: Model ID for the openai-codex provider (see: pi --list-models).

preferences.name: thinking
preferences.title: Thinking Level
preferences.description: Lower is faster. 'off' is ideal for spelling/grammar fixes.

preferences.name: fastMode
preferences.title: OpenAI Fast Mode
preferences.label: Request priority service tier (fast mode)
preferences.description: Sends service_tier=priority with each request, like the Codex fast mode toggle.
